safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention neck stiffness (denial or presence).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute/severe headache, documenting absence of neck stiffness helps risk-stratify for meningitis/SAH and supports safe outpatient management. Omitting this negative finding can lead subsequent clinicians to treat it as “not assessed,” potentially prompting unnecessary escalation or repeat evaluation.
